products.name: Pinecone
products.note: Vector database; RAG infrastructure; data residency options; enterprise security

profile_text.body:
Pinecone is a New York-based company founded in 2019 that provides a fully managed vector database built for AI applications. The company describes its core offering as enabling search through billions of items for similar matches to any object in milliseconds, positioning this as a next-generation search capability accessible via an API call.

Pinecone's primary product is its vector database platform, which the company says features instant searchability for writes, automatic indexing, and consistent query performance at scale. The product is categorized as a developer and coding tool and is described as infrastructure for retrieval-augmented generation, or RAG, with data residency options and enterprise security included.

The held facts note a New York law exposure count of 299, which reflects the volume of relevant legal activity associated with that jurisdiction, though no specific litigation cases are recorded for the company at this time.
